prompt: Single continuous shot. Three ingredients in hard spotlight: sausages, potatoes, a jar of cream cheese — one second still. Then motion: potatoes sliced into thin rounds falling in a cascade, sausages cut diagonally, everything layered fast into a baking dish, cream cheese dolloped and dragged into streaks, cheese snowing over. Money shot: out of the oven bubbling, a spoon punching through the golden crust with a crack, lifting a steaming scoop with cheese stretching, backlit. Final beat: the scoop landing on a plate. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the potato cascade, then the crust crack. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption: Como prometido: o trio da vergonha — que assado direito vira gratinado honesto que a casa disputa. **Sábado que vem: [A] sardinha em lata, macarrão e limão ou [B] pão amanhecido, leite e queijo? Comenta A ou B 👇**
